links.outcome: Whether single-turn clinical QA performance transfers to multi-turn, evidence-grounded discharge-summary QA
links.effect: Across 22 LLMs, single-turn clinical QA performance did not reliably transfer to the multi-turn setting; evidence grounding was harder than content answering, and multi-turn errors compounded. No numbers in abstract.
links.quote: Benchmarking 22 open- and closed-source LLMs reveals several challenges, including that LLMs struggle more with evidence grounding than content answering, multi-turn errors compound across turns, and single-turn clinical QA performance does not reliably transfer to this setting.

screen.reason: Introduces and evaluates 22 LLMs on EHRNote-ChatQA, a new benchmark dataset for evidence-grounded multi-turn clinical question answering over longitudinal EHR discharge summaries.
